digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria registry and reviewer prompts
propositions: Dual vocabulary 'Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts causes pooling and applies a single bar across both terms, introducing noise in rubrics and generated criteria guides.
All instances of 'Success Criteria' must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts and criteria routing, with the generated criteria guide regenerated from updated sources.

Three sites must be deliberately excluded from renaming: plan_review_T2.md uses 'success criteria' as generic English for experiment metrics (not the ticket heading), and plan_review_verifier files use 'success criterion' in the dod_uncertifiable context which is out of scope.

Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp, invalidating in-flight attestations; this change is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) merges to enable grandfathering at the claim gate.

Verification requires registry_version to differ before and after the routing edit, the generated guide to retain exactly one 'success criteria' match (in excluded T2), and lint/typecheck/full test suite to pass.
